bootstrap.implementation: Independent NumPy recomputation; no import of project estimate/summarize_rows functions.
bootstrap.method: For each task in sorted order resample its six whole source means with replacement; retain all eight paired suffixes together; sum 30 sampled means and divide by 30; percentile [0.025,0.975].
bootstrap.intervals: Nominal 95%; no multiplicity correction across methods or comparisons; not independent validation intervals.

mechanism_conclusions: At the fixed matched command metric, forward direct guidance beats reverse by +18.333333 pp (nominal CI [7.5,30.416667]) and structured random by +23.75 pp ([10.833333,38.333333]); this supports useful local directional information on this development distribution.

Direct matched versus velocity matched is 0 pp (CI [-8.75,8.75]); there is no demonstrated aggregate advantage from removing the extra tau factor. Analytic and actual sampler preflight checks already verified update signs.

Post matched is +9.166667 pp over replan (CI [1.25,18.75]), with 25 rescues and 3 harms. Its +3.333333 pp point advantage over direct matched has CI [-1.25,10.416667], so flow injection has not been proven inferior or unnecessary.

Native direct increases predicted gain by +25.538444 pp but has actual -17.5 pp. Matched direct and post have negative source-level predicted/actual gain correlations. Local directional usefulness is distinct from calibrated gain magnitudes, accurate per-source ranking or reliability at larger radii.

Native-to-matched contrasts jointly alter command magnitude, boundary support and XYZ/gripper proportions; they support importance of the final command handling but cannot identify amplitude alone or gripper adjustment alone as the causal component.
report_risks: All results are development observations; selected best post score is not independent confirmation. Nominal intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted.
Post point gain exceeds the approximate +5 pp target, but its lower confidence bound is +1.25 pp and does not establish a guaranteed gain of at least +5 pp.

Post improves six sources, harms two, and leaves 22 unchanged. Net +22 paired successes consist of +12 shelf-place, +8 stick-pull, +2 disassemble; pick-place-wall and stick-push baselines are already 48/48.
Matched grip normalization can strongly amplify tiny native components; final direction comparisons apply to the registered group metric, not an unchanged native sampler.
Future validation must freeze the selected post implementation including all methods needed to determine its shared feasible radius; an isolated cheap post version would be a different method.
